286263.f: May the Holy Light protect us on our expedition to the frozen north.

286264.f: I really wish you mages would get your heads out from inside your own... books.

286265.f: May my sisters realize their full potential, the name Windrunner known as a result of their deeds.

286266.f: Grant me the strength to accept the things that I cannot change, the courage to change the things I can, and the wisdom to know the difference.

286267.f: Oh, why won't you notice me? Abbendis, I would follow you anywhere. I wish you would notice me...

286268.f: I pray that when the time comes, I will have the strength to thwart the forces beyond the gate.

286270.f: How does this fountain even work? I wonder if I could make one.

286271.f: Turalyon and Alleria, wherever you are, may you be well.

286272.f: May my son Arthas always act in the best interest of his people.

286274.f: <You sense the ringing of three tones in your head, the third barely audible under the others' din.>

286275.f: I hope that my father and brothers outlive me. I'll not make much of a king.

286279.f: I wish I would grow up, it feels like I've been 10 for years.

286280.f: Young Arthas must learn patience to temper his power. I will pray that he one day learns how to lead with care rather than force.

286281.f: Already, I've a kingdom in my prospects, a land to rule. What to ask for? Perhaps a frozen scone...

286283.f: I wish someday to retire to my own tidy little estate, with a bunch of pet dogs to keep me company.

286287.f: Sometimes... I wish someone would come along and just give me a big, long hug.

286288.f: Arthas, my love, please come back to me.

286290.f: Listen, little wishing fountain. You'll give me all your power if you know what's good for you.

286291.f: I hope my sisters and I can grow up and get married together. This coin appears to be very old.

286292.f: It is my wish that my dear Taelan will grow strong enough to defend the people he cares for.

286293.f: I wish to know how you survived my wrath, little fountain.

286294.f: Explain my dreams, little fountain. Why must I always be viewing my kin from above and moving them like pawns?

286298.f: It seems my moonlighting days as a postal worker are coming to an end.

286299.f: Grom, may you rest well, old friend.

286300.f: This doesn't make sense. Why am I putting a coin in a fountain?

286302.f: The amount of coins shining in the pool. Maybe no one will notice if I take just one.

286304.f: Wish I had that cousin of mine's duty to do nothing more than lug wood around carelessly...

286306.f: I wish Captain Sanders would hurry up with my shipment of wine.

286307.f: I wish for happiness and acceptance for my daughter. She feels so out of place here...

286308.f: Can I have a more comfortable saddle? My hindquarters ache.

286309.f: I hope a troll dies, right... NOW.

286310.f: Being a rogue is hard work. Someday I hope to pursue my life's one true passion...

286311.f: I hope I end up in another book eventually.

286312.f: I wish I had my father back...

286313.f: I wish I'd kept that coin...

286314.f: I wish people would stop knocking my toys off the shelf.

286315.f: I could have used this copper for something productive. Perhaps something with string and a machine.

286317.f: How does a tavern run out of ale!

286318.f: I miss my sword and shield. I feel so naked without my sword and shield.

286327.f: Here you go, Nozdormu. What was I supposed to do after this?

286328.f: How do I prove they copied us with this fountain?
